header:
from typing import assert_type
from snekql import sqlite
from scratchpad.dual_descriptors.application import User, UserRow, Post, PostRow, Transaction, table, insert, insert_many
from scratchpad.paired_advanced.contracts import UserId, PostId, AccountSummary, BalanceGroup, ReferralStep, FirstRole, SecondRole
async def caller(transaction: Transaction, start: UserId, max_depth: int=8)->None:
challenge:
users = table(UserRow)
identity = UserRow.user_id.label('user_id')
parent = UserRow.inviter_id.label('inviter_id')
depth = sqlite.literal(0).label('depth')
anchor = sqlite.select(users).where(UserRow.user_id.eq(start)).project(ReferralStep, user_id=identity, inviter_id=parent, depth=depth)
walk = sqlite.recursive_cte(anchor, FirstRole, name='referrals').step(lambda previous: sqlite.select(users).join(previous, on=previous.column(parent).eq_col(UserRow.user_id)).where(previous.column(depth).lt(max_depth)).project(ReferralStep, user_id=identity, inviter_id=parent, depth=previous.column(depth).add(1)))
assert_type(await transaction.fetch_all(sqlite.select(walk).all().order_by(walk.column(depth).asc())),list[ReferralStep])
